build_PatchEmbed: build a PatchEmbed module that converts 2D or 3D image tensors into patch embeddings with configurable patch size and embedding dimension
create_TimestepEmbedder: create a TimestepEmbedder that maps scalar timesteps into vector representations using sinusoidal frequency embeddings and an MLP
create_timestep_embedding: create sinusoidal timestep embeddings from a batch of timesteps with configurable dimension and max period
build_CombinedTimestepGuidanceTextProjEm: build a CombinedTimestepGuidanceTextProjEmbeddings module that combines timestep, guidance, and text projections into a unified embedding
run_unpatchify: run unpatchify to convert a patched tensor back into image space with given temporal, spatial dimensions and patch size
